headline: 愛丁堡藝穗節劇評兩則
context: 愛丁堡藝穗節這邊，兩齣新戲拿到劇評。西班牙劇團 Yllana 的《Flamenc Oh!!》，用佛朗明哥舞混搭喜劇手法，講傳統與現代的拉鋸。另一齣《A Foot Is Not an Appropriate Prize for the Tombola》，則是一場從園遊會攤位滑進宇宙驚悚的荒誕喜劇。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Assembly Hall, Edinburgh Can you dance flamenco to Eye of the Tiger? Of course, says the company Yllana, in a flamboyant celebration of breaking down barriers You don’t need to know anything about flamenco to enjoy Flamenc Oh!! That overuse of exclamation marks gives you an idea of the subtlety of this fun/silly dance-comedy by Spanish company Yllana , based on flamenco’s battle between tradition and modernity (which is a real thing in the flamenco world, with its division between purists and progressives). Here is our patriarch with his straight spine and authoritarian streak, banning all music other than flamenco from his family. There’s mother and daughter in polka dots and frills, the son forever trying (and failing) to impress his dad, and their hunk of a cousin who has returned from his travels with some new guitar chords and a love of the blues, ready to upset the status quo. sources.title: Flamenc Oh!! review – frills, flirting and fierce footwork in breezy Spanish comedy

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Pleasance Courtyard, Edinburgh Daniel McVey merrily recruits the audience for a fun hour of cosy crime that bleeds into cosmic horror With a title like that, perhaps it’s no surprise that this afternoon’s show is sold out. Who wouldn’t want to find out how a stray limb ended up in a village fete’s raffle? Writer, performer and director Daniel McVey greets us as his drag character Lydia, a woman who rules over local festivities with a strict schedule – and a firm grip on the tombola. Audience members are encouraged to get up and have a go, and not just that: they’re also cast in McVey’s play as glove puppeteers, actors and – gasp! – suspects in a terrible murder. At Pleasance Courtyard, Edinburgh , until 31 August All our Edinburgh festival reviews Continue reading...

thread_text:
愛丁堡藝穗節這邊，兩齣新戲拿到劇評。西班牙劇團 Yllana 的《Flamenc Oh!!》，把佛朗明哥舞混搭喜劇手法，講傳統與現代之間的拉鋸——劇評形容，不需要懂佛朗明哥，也能看得開心。

另一齣《A Foot Is Not an Appropriate Prize for the Tombola》，編導丹尼爾・麥克維（Daniel McVey）親自扮演角色 Lydia，帶觀眾一起玩園遊會攤位遊戲，劇情從溫馨小奇案，一路滑進宇宙驚悚。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 15 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
